From: Kayla Torres <ktorres@helixhealth.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@helixhealth.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Helix Health — VPC evaluation and security gating

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. We are ready to spin up a short VPC-backed POC of Redwood to validate data residency and encryption controls with our platform team, but we hit a gating item on our side: we need a short-term promotional credit allocation tied to a security evidence review so our procurement and finance teams can justify the sandbox spend during the audit window.

High level asks from our side:
- A modest promotional credit for a 3-week VPC pilot (estimate: ~$2k)
- A list of security artifacts you can provide (SOC2 snapshot, network diagram, KMS attestations)
- Confirmation that the POC will run in an isolated VPC with customer-managed keys

Can you confirm whether Redwood can sponsor this evaluation and what artifacts you can produce within 3 business days? Procurement is on copy for budget sign-off.

Thanks — Kayla
Kayla Torres
Director, Cloud Integrations
Helix Health
[Attachment: POC_Request_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helix Health — VPC evaluation and security gating

Hi Kayla —

Appreciate the context. We can absolutely support a VPC-backed POC and sponsor trial credits for security-driven evaluations. Quick summary of what we can do immediately: 

- Sponsor a short promo credit pool for the POC (preliminary approval: $2,000 in hosted credits tied to the POC environment).
- Provide a SOC2 snapshot export and our standard network diagram within 48 hours (see attached mandate form to confirm the scope).
- Offer a temporary customer-managed KMS configuration guide and a walkthrough with our Security Solutions Engineer during onboarding.

Next steps / asks from Helix:
1) Sign the attached mandate form (just covers POC scope and data handling) — I attached the PDF stub.
2) Share any additional artifact requirements (e.g., encryption cipher lists, key rotation cadence, audit logs retention windows).
3) Confirm schedule for a 1-hour onboarding call with our SecEng (we can do Wed or Thu next week).

If you need the credit bucket increased based on projected token consumption, we can escalate to finance but will need a short justification note from procurement.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Initial_Mandate_Form.pdf (pdf)]

Alex / Kayla —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Alex. A couple of additional items from the security review: 

- We need a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II sub-service organization report or a time-limited SOC2 snapshot export showing coverage for encryption, access control, and logging.
- Confirmation that the POC instance will not share KV caches with multi-tenant hosted models (we require strict KV isolation for test data).
- Evidence of customer-managed key support (HSM/KMS proof or architecture note).
- Requesting an extension of the POC window to 3 weeks (target end date Jan 31) and a credit increase to $3,500 to cover initial ingestion and load tests — procurement will use that number in the budget workbook.

We can sign the mandate form once you provide the SOC2 snapshot and the KV isolation confirmation. Also, please include a point of contact for security questions (name + email) for our audit team.

Following our internal review, we can approve a conditional POC subsidy to help Helix complete the VPC evaluation. Approval summary below: 

- Approved promo credit: $3,500 (applies only to the Helix VPC POC environment, account HLX-POC-001).
- Approved POC window: 2026-01-11 through 2026-01-31 (we will auto-expire remaining credits after 31 Jan).
- Conditions: Helix must provide the SOC2 snapshot export and a short confirmation that KV caches are isolated for the POC environment prior to the credits being applied.
- Artifacts required (upload to the shared drive link below): SOC2_Snapshot.csv, Network_Diagram.pdf, KMS_Attestation.txt

I have attached the formal approval document and included a DocuSign link for our Data Processing Addendum (DPA). Once the DPA is countersigned and we receive the artifacts above, the credit bucket will be applied and Alex will coordinate onboarding.
